name: Atlassian
h1: One connected layer for the work around the work
lede: As growth guidance resets for FY27, a connected system for planning and operations keeps programs on track.
why_p: Recent public signals point to a company scaling AI-driven work while managing a more measured growth outlook.

signals.title: FY27 Q1 beat, but growth guidance slows
signals.body: Revenue of $1.772B, up 24%, with cloud revenue up 31%. Subscription ARR growth is guided to slow from 22.5% to about 18.5% by year-end.
signals.angle: A tighter growth outlook raises the value of one source of truth for planning, forecasting and cross-team programs.

signals.title: Teamwork Graph opened up for agentic work
signals.body: Atlassian says its Teamwork Graph has over 150 billion connections and Rovo is used by over 75% of the Fortune 500.
signals.angle: As agents multiply, teams need structured, connected data that people and agents can both work from.

signals.title: Leadership transition and cost discipline
signals.body: President Anu Bharadwaj left at the end of 2025 after 12 years, and about 150 roles were cut around the FY25 results.
signals.angle: Leadership and structure changes put a premium on shared, easy-to-maintain operating workflows.
